name: Events Countdown
changelog: v1.5.0: Upgraded card sizing to executive medium (~88px) with 44px avatar bubbles. Added exact completed age breakdown (years, months, days) directly on every birthday card. Introduced Smart Horizon Countdown Engine: shows relative calendar horizon (e.g. '7M 12D') for birthdays/events > 1 month away, and exact days countdown ('14d left', 'Tomorrow!', 'TODAY!') within 30 days.
